name: Western Digital
description: Western Digital is now a pure hard disk drive (HDD) company. It spun its flash business off as Sandisk on 2025-02-21 and has since sold every Sandisk share it kept. Cloud (hyperscale data center) drives are 89 percent of revenue and the top ten customers are 73 percent, three of them 16, 15 and 13 percent. Revenue rose 36 percent to $12.9B in fiscal 2026 and operating margin rose from 24.5 to 34.5 percent. Reported net income from continuing operations of $9.4B is far above operating income of $4.5B because of a $6.5B gain on the retained Sandisk shares, which is not HDD earnings.
